title: Identify AGB Low-Battery Flashing Red Condition and Charge Requirement (under 30%)
summary: Use the AGB’s low-battery indicator to confirm the documented condition: when an AGB battery level is under 30%, the AGB starts flashing red, indicating it needs to charge.
when_to_use: When you need to determine whether an AGB is in the documented low-battery condition (battery level under 30%) based on the AGB’s flashing red indication, and you need to know that it requires charging.
not_for: Do not assume low-battery/under-30% status if the AGB is not flashing red; stop and escalate instead.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Observe the AGB indicator behavior (flashing vs steady) and apply the under-30% flashing-red rule to decide that the AGB needs charging.
safety_notes: If you cannot safely access/observe the AGB indicator, stop and escalate rather than guessing the battery condition.
access_or_tools_needed: Visual access to the AGB indicator/light

system_preconditions: An AGB is present and its indicator/light can be observed

visual_references.description: Training frame showing the rule: under 30% battery => AGB starts flashing red; it needs to charge.

steps.title: Locate the AGB and observe its battery/indicator behavior
steps.purpose: Identify the correct AGB and verify the indicator behavior needed to apply the under-30% flashing-red rule.
steps.instruction: Visually locate the AGB and look at its battery/indicator light so you can determine whether it is flashing red (not steady).
steps.expected_result: You can observe the AGB indicator behavior clearly enough to determine whether it is flashing red.
steps.healthy_condition: The AGB indicator is visible and you can distinguish flashing red vs steady red.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot safely access/observe the AGB indicator, or you cannot determine whether it is flashing.
stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot safely access/observe the AGB indicator, stop and escalate rather than guessing.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript: 'under 30% is when the AGB will start flashing red. It needs to charge neatly.'

steps.title: Determine whether the AGB indicator is flashing red (not steady)
steps.purpose: Confirm the indicator pattern required by the documented rule (flashing red vs steady).
steps.instruction: Check whether the AGB’s red indicator is flashing (intermittent) rather than steady.
steps.expected_result: You determine whether the AGB indicator is flashing red.
steps.healthy_condition: The indicator is clearly flashing red (not steady).
steps.failure_condition: The indicator is not flashing red (e.g., steady red or no red flashing).

actions.label: Check flashing vs steady
actions.exact_action: Determine whether the AGB indicator is flashing red (not steady).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the AGB is not flashing red but other symptoms suggest low battery, stop and escalate rather than assuming the condition.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript: 'under 30% is when the AGB will start flashing red.'

steps.title: Use the documented threshold: under 30% corresponds to flashing red
steps.purpose: Map the observed flashing-red condition to the documented battery threshold (under 30%).
steps.instruction: If the AGB is flashing red, treat it as the documented condition that occurs when battery level is under 30%.
steps.expected_result: You correlate the observed flashing-red indicator with the under-30% low-battery condition.
steps.healthy_condition: AGB is flashing red, and you conclude it matches the under-30% condition.
steps.failure_condition: You conclude under-30% based on an indicator state that is not flashing red.

actions.label: Apply under-30% flashing-red rule
actions.exact_action: If the AGB is flashing red, treat it as the condition that occurs when battery level is under 30%.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the AGB is not flashing red, do not apply the under-30% rule; stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript: 'under 30% is when the AGB will start flashing red.'

steps.title: Plan to charge the AGB as indicated by the flashing-red low-battery condition
steps.purpose: Take the documented next action: a flashing-red AGB needs charging.
steps.instruction: If the AGB is flashing red (under 30%), plan to charge the AGB to address the low-battery condition.
steps.expected_result: You determine that the AGB needs to be charged based on the flashing-red indication.
steps.healthy_condition: AGB is flashing red and you treat it as requiring charging.
steps.failure_condition: You proceed as if the AGB does not need charging despite flashing red.

actions.label: Charge the AGB
actions.exact_action: Plan to charge the AGB as indicated by the training statement (“It needs to charge neatly”).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the AGB is not flashing red, stop and escalate rather than charging based on an assumed under-30% condition.

success_criteria: Operator observes the AGB indicator and correctly identifies whether it is flashing red.
When flashing red is observed, the operator correlates it to the under-30% low-battery condition and treats the AGB as needing charging.
healthy_conditions: AGB indicator is flashing red (not steady) and the operator applies the under-30% rule.
failure_conditions: AGB is not flashing red but the operator assumes under-30% low battery.
Operator cannot safely observe the indicator and guesses the condition.
escalation_guidance: If the AGB is not flashing red but other symptoms suggest low battery, stop and escalate rather than assuming the condition.
If you cannot safely access/observe the AGB indicator, stop and escalate rather than guessing.

The packet does not provide the exact charging procedure steps (e.g., which module/UI to use to initiate charging) beyond the statement that it needs to charge.
